chunks: One of our companions, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from al-Abbas ibn Aamir, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) married Fatima (peace be upon her) to Ali (peace be upon him) with a dower of a cracked shield valued at thirty dirhams.

key_terms.دِرْعٍ حُطَمِيَّةٍ: A cracked or worn shield, used here as the specific item of the dowry
key_terms.دِرْهَماً: A silver coin, the unit of currency used to value the dowry
key_terms.زَوَّجَ: He married (someone) / He gave in marriage

ai.seo_question: What was the dowry given for the marriage of Imam Ali and Fatima?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights the profound humility of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) in arranging the marriage of Imam Ali and Fatima (peace be upon them), emphasizing that the dowry was a simple, cracked shield valued at only thirty dirhams. This incident serves as a key scholarly reference for the principle of *sadaq* (dowry) in Shia jurisprudence, illustrating that spiritual worth outweighs material wealth and setting a precedent for modesty in marital unions among the Ahl al-Bayt.
